name: valendata
description: Valendata for AI coding agents: the Valendata MCP server (sign in through the browser) and a skill that teaches the agent to find, clone, run, create and schedule Valendata skills and workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Website data as rows, through your Valendata skills
interface.longDescription: Find, clone, run, create and schedule Valendata skills and workflows. Each skill takes inputs and returns rows from a website in the same shape every time, and repairs itself when the site changes. Every run spends credits from your Valendata account.
defaultPrompt: Use Valendata to find a skill that lists 20 laptops on eBay under $500, then run it.
